name: miricanvas
description: Create presentations, social media posts, and posters from MiriCanvas templates through conversation in ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Bring MiriCanvas into ChatGPT to get template recommendations and finish your designs through natural conversation.

What you can do with MiriCanvas:
- Create designs: Make presentations, social media posts, posters, and more from a topic, outline, or script.
- Get template recommendations: Get templates that match your content or the mood you want, then create a design right away from the one you choose.
- Change colors: Recreate a template you like in the colors you want (e.g., "in blue tones", "in a warm tone").

Once connected, just describe the design you want, or call @MiriCanvas directly.

Try saying:
- @MiriCanvas Make a 10-slide onboarding deck for new employees
- @MiriCanvas Turn the attached report into an executive briefing presentation
- @MiriCanvas Recommend lesson templates for elementary school students
- @MiriCanvas Make a university group project presentation on environmental issues
- @MiriCanvas Make a presentation summarizing our family trip itinerary
- @MiriCanvas Turn a Margherita pizza recipe into a social media post
- @MiriCanvas Make a poster promoting a flea market
- @MiriCanvas Make a poster with tips for managing indoor humidity in winter
- @MiriCanvas Make a social media post announcing our company year-end party schedule

Requirements: You need to connect a MiriCanvas account to use this plugin.

Your designs are saved to your MiriCanvas account. Edit them freely in the editor, or download them as PPTX, PDF, and more.
capabilities: Recommend MiriCanvas templates that match your topic and mood
Create presentations, social media posts, and posters from a template with your content
Recolor a template in the colors you want
Add charts and tables to your design
Use your own photos from chat attachments, web links, or your MiriCanvas drive
Find photos, illustrations, and icons for your design
Save designs to your MiriCanvas team and open them in the editor
defaultPrompt: Make a MiriCanvas presentation introducing healthy lifestyle habits.
Recommend a clean, blue-toned business presentation template from MiriCanvas.
Make a MiriCanvas business plan presentation for a new cafe in a warm, cozy style.

positive.description: Create a presentation from a one-line topic. If a template picker appears, select any template.
positive.prompt: Make a MiriCanvas presentation to present at a team meeting, introducing healthy lifestyle habits for office workers.
positive.tools_triggered: get_miricanvas_guide, search_templates, get_template_page_previews, show_template_choices, get_template_structure, prepare_design_plan, check_design_plan, create_design
positive.expected_behavior: Recommends presentation templates that match the topic and creates an editable presentation about healthy lifestyle habits for office workers. Returns a thumbnail and an edit button that opens the design in the MiriCanvas editor.

positive.description: Create a class presentation from a topic, with a quiz at the end. If a template picker appears, select any template.
positive.prompt: Make a MiriCanvas presentation for a middle school science class on the water cycle, with a short quiz at the end.
positive.tools_triggered: get_miricanvas_guide, search_templates, get_template_page_previews, show_template_choices, get_template_structure, prepare_design_plan, check_design_plan, create_design
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an editable presentation about the water cycle that covers evaporation, condensation, precipitation, and collection, and ends with a short quiz. Returns a thumbnail and an edit button.

positive.description: Create a card news set (a multi-page social media post). The request names the design type, so the plugin does not need to ask which type to make. If a template picker appears, select any template.
positive.prompt: Make a MiriCanvas card news set with 5 tips for staying healthy during seasonal changes.
positive.tools_triggered: get_miricanvas_guide, search_templates, get_template_page_previews, show_template_choices, get_template_structure, prepare_design_plan, check_design_plan, create_design
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an editable card news design from a card news template, containing five tips for staying healthy during seasonal changes. Returns a thumbnail and an edit button.

positive.description: Create a poster that keeps the event details exactly as given and does not invent contact details. If a template picker appears, select any template.
positive.prompt: Make a MiriCanvas poster for a book talk at Greenwood Library on Saturday, October 24 at 2 PM. Free entry.
positive.tools_triggered: get_miricanvas_guide, search_templates, get_template_page_previews, show_template_choices, get_template_structure, prepare_design_plan, check_design_plan, create_design
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an editable poster showing the venue, date, time, and "Free entry" as given. The template's sample phone numbers, addresses, or websites are removed instead of being filled with invented values. Returns a thumbnail and an edit button.

positive.description: Create a presentation that follows the section order given in the prompt, using placeholders for company details that were not given. If a template picker appears, select any template.
positive.prompt: Make a MiriCanvas presentation to present at new employee orientation: company overview, team, tools, and first-week schedule. Use placeholders for company details.
positive.tools_triggered: get_miricanvas_guide, search_templates, get_template_page_previews, show_template_choices, get_template_structure, prepare_design_plan, check_design_plan, create_design
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an editable presentation that covers company overview, team, tools, and first-week schedule in that order, with placeholders instead of invented company names, dates, or figures. Returns a thumbnail and an edit button.

negative.description: The user asks for more than 30 pages in one design. A design can have at most 30 pages, so the plugin should explain the limit and make up to 30 pages or split the content into multiple designs, instead of creating a single 50-page design.
negative.prompt: Make a 50-slide MiriCanvas presentation on the history of jazz.

negative.description: The user asks for designs in another company's team workspace that the connected account is not a member of. The plugin can only use the account and workspace connected by the user, so it should explain that it cannot access other workspaces and should not show or create any design.
negative.prompt: Show me the MiriCanvas designs in Acme Corp's team workspace. I'm not a member of that team.

negative.description: The user asks for a poster that claims a product cures cancer. This is a false medical claim, so the plugin should not create a design with the claim. It may offer to make a poster without the claim.
negative.prompt: Make a MiriCanvas poster saying our herbal tea cures cancer, so we can sell it at the market.

publication.release_notes: Removed "card news" from the English search keywords and changed it to "carousel" in the Japanese search keywords and listing text.

ko-KR.subtitle: 대화로 만드는 PPT·카드뉴스·포스터
ko-KR.description:
미리캔버스를 ChatGPT로 가져와, 자연스러운 대화로 템플릿을 추천받고 디자인을 완성해 보세요.

미리캔버스로 할 수 있는 일:
- 디자인 만들기: 주제, 개요, 원고를 바탕으로 프레젠테이션, 카드뉴스, 포스터 등을 만들 수 있어요.
- 템플릿 추천: 내용이나 원하는 분위기에 어울리는 템플릿을 추천해 드려요. 선택한 템플릿으로 디자인을 바로 만들 수 있어요.
- 색감 바꾸기: 마음에 드는 템플릿을 원하는 색으로 바꿔 만들 수 있어요. (예: "파란색 계열로", "따뜻한 톤으로")

연결한 뒤에는 원하는 디자인을 편하게 말하거나, @MiriCanvas로 바로 불러 보세요.

이렇게 말해 보세요:
- @MiriCanvas 신입사원 온보딩 교육 자료를 10장짜리 슬라이드로 만들어줘
- @MiriCanvas 첨부한 보고서를 임원 보고용 발표 자료로 만들어줘
- @MiriCanvas 초등학생 대상 수업 자료 템플릿 추천해줘
- @MiriCanvas 환경 문제를 주제로 한 대학교 조별 과제 보고서 PPT 만들어줘
- @MiriCanvas 가족 여행 일정을 정리한 발표 자료 만들어줘
- @MiriCanvas 마르게리타 피자 레시피를 카드뉴스로 만들어줘
- @MiriCanvas 플리마켓 홍보 포스터 만들어줘
- @MiriCanvas 겨울철 실내 습도 관리 팁을 포스터로 만들어줘
- @MiriCanvas 사내 연말 송년회 일정을 안내하는 카드뉴스 만들어줘

이용 조건: 미리캔버스 계정을 연결해야 사용할 수 있어요.

만든 디자인은 내 미리캔버스에 저장돼요. 에디터에서 원하는 대로 편집하거나 PPTX, PDF 등으로 다운로드해 보세요.

ja-JP.subtitle: プレゼンとデザインを作成
ja-JP.description:
MiriCanvasをChatGPTで使って、自然な会話でテンプレートの提案を受け、デザインを仕上げましょう。

MiriCanvasでできること:
- デザイン作成: テーマ、構成、原稿をもとに、プレゼンテーション、カルーセル、ポスターなどを作成できます。
- テンプレートの提案: 内容や希望の雰囲気に合うテンプレートを提案します。選んだテンプレートですぐにデザインを作成できます。
- 配色の変更: 気に入ったテンプレートを好きな色に変えて作成できます。（例:「青系で」「温かみのあるトーンで」）

接続後は、作りたいデザインを気軽に伝えるか、@MiriCanvasで直接呼び出してください。

こんなふうに話しかけてみてください:
- @MiriCanvas 新入社員オンボーディング研修資料を10枚のスライドで作って
- @MiriCanvas 添付した報告書を役員報告用のプレゼン資料にして
- @MiriCanvas 小学生向けの授業資料テンプレートをおすすめして
- @MiriCanvas 環境問題をテーマにした大学のグループ課題のスライドを作って
- @MiriCanvas 家族旅行の日程をまとめたプレゼン資料を作って
- @MiriCanvas マルゲリータピザのレシピをカルーセルにして
- @MiriCanvas フリーマーケットの告知ポスターを作って
- @MiriCanvas 冬の室内湿度管理のコツをポスターにして
- @MiriCanvas 社内忘年会のスケジュールを案内するカルーセルを作って

ご利用条件: MiriCanvasアカウントの連携が必要です。

作成したデザインはMiriCanvasに保存されます。エディタで自由に編集したり、PPTX、PDFなどでダウンロードしたりできます。
